# anecdotes_control_implementation (Resource)

Manages the implementation text of an Anecdotes control: how the control is implemented.

Works on any control, whether it was created in your account or provided with a framework.
The resource manages only the implementation text. It never creates or deletes the control.

Creating the resource sets the text on a control that has none. A control that already
has implementation text must be imported first, so existing text is never replaced without
an explicit `terraform import`. Destroying the resource clears the text and leaves
the control and its other fields unchanged.

Use one `anecdotes_control_implementation` per control, across all configurations.
Two resources on the same control overwrite each other's text on every apply.

The text is stored as written. Line breaks are kept. Text formatted in the Anecdotes
application is stored as HTML, so an imported control's text can contain HTML tags.

## Relationships

```
Control (anecdotes_control, or provided with a framework)
    └── Implementation text (this resource)
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A control provided with a framework: look it up, then manage its
# implementation text. The control itself is never created or deleted.
data "anecdotes_controls" "soc2_access" {
  framework_id  = "fw_12345"
  name_contains = "CC6.1"
}

resource "anecdotes_control_implementation" "cc6_1" {
  control_id = data.anecdotes_controls.soc2_access.controls[0].control_id

  control_implementation = <<-EOT
    Access to production systems requires single sign-on with MFA.
    Access rights are reviewed quarterly by the security team.
  EOT
}

# A control created in Terraform works the same way.
resource "anecdotes_framework_folder" "compliance" {
  name = "Compliance Frameworks"
}

resource "anecdotes_framework" "internal" {
  name        = "Internal Controls"
  description = "Controls defined by our organization"
  folder_id   = anecdotes_framework_folder.compliance.folder_id
}

resource "anecdotes_control_category" "operations" {
  framework_id = anecdotes_framework.internal.framework_id
  name         = "Operations"
}

resource "anecdotes_control" "backups" {
  framework_id = anecdotes_framework.internal.framework_id
  category_id  = anecdotes_control_category.operations.category_id
  name         = "Production data is backed up daily"
}

resource "anecdotes_control_implementation" "backups" {
  control_id             = anecdotes_control.backups.control_id
  control_implementation = "Nightly snapshots are kept for 35 days and restored in a quarterly drill."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `control_id` (String) The ID of the control whose implementation text this resource manages (e.g., `control_55312`). Changing it replaces the resource.
- `control_implementation` (String) How the control is implemented. Line breaks are kept. To clear the text, remove the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the implementation text of a control by control_id. Required before
# managing a control that already has implementation text.
terraform import anecdotes_control_implementation.example control_55312
```
